title: Winnie | Hooded Cardigan That Works All Year
bodyHtml:
This is the cardigan you'll reach for without thinking, whether it's a cool winter's day or a mild spring afternoon. Layer it over a tee or blouse when the chill hits, or wear it solo once the weather softens – it's got that perfect balance of warmth without the bulk. It moves with you through the seasons, adapting to whatever the day throws at you, which is exactly why you'll come back to it again and again.

Why you'll love it

  • The ultimate layering piece – slips effortlessly over a top, blouse or lightweight jumper to add warmth without weighing you down
  • Stays cosy through changing seasons – warm enough for cool days, light enough to wear solo when temperatures climb
  • Soft comfort that doesn't cling – wraps you gently from morning through evening, at home, at work, or on the move
  • Works with everything, all year round – wear it open or buttoned, pair it with jeans, trousers, dresses or skirts for an instant pulled-together look
  • The hooded detail adds a relaxed, versatile edge
  • Incredibly hard to find – made exclusively for our 30-year celebration collection, with very limited stock and no restocking

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
